question: On SiP tasks estimated in 2010, does any listed correction have a lower MAE than the shipped size-only model?
data: SiP effort estimation dataset, Derek-Jones/SiP_dataset @ fed32c65e974bdcabd417c695508fed05f93c215, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, paper https://arxiv.org/abs/1901.01621. Same rows as parallax.empirical.load_sip_tasks.
does_not_repeat: Jev overrun tertile turned into extra hours
test_fit: estimated_on < 2011-01-01; a recent-window candidate also drops rows before its start date
test_score: estimated_on >= 2011-01-01, and only for the single promoted candidate
quantile: numpy.quantile default linear, the same call RatioQuantileModel uses

bootstrap.restart: each candidate builds a new numpy Generator from this seed, so the 5000 index vectors match
bootstrap.gain: mean absolute error of size-only minus mean absolute error of the candidate, on paired resamples of task indices
bootstrap.ci: numpy.quantile of the 5000 gains at 0.025 and 0.975

promotion: Among candidates with unrounded P10-P90 coverage percent >= 75, unrounded MAE strictly below size-only, and bootstrap CI lower bound strictly above 0, pick the lowest unrounded MAE. If two MAEs are equal, the earlier candidate in this list wins. If none qualify, promote nobody.
multiplicity: Eight candidates share the 2010 screen. Clearing it is not a family-wise 95% claim. The only accuracy claim is the single 2011-2014 score, and only if a candidate is promoted.
if_none_promoted: Write datasets/eval/sip_correction_choice.json and append journal tag sip_correction_validation. Do not write sip_correction_test.json. Do not score any task estimated on or after 2011-01-01.
if_promoted: Write the choice file and do not append a journal line yet. Commit that choice file before running test. test scores only the promoted id, refit on the test_fit window.
ship_eligible: On 2011-2014 the promoted model has MAE strictly below size-only, coverage >= 75, and MAE-gain CI lower bound strictly above 0. Otherwise it is not shipped. The script does not edit apps/.

integrity_check.on_fail: exit without writing a choice file and without appending the journal

crash_rule: A crash before the choice file exists may be fixed and the command rerun. The candidate list, order, parameters, and promotion rule may not change after this file is committed.

mechanisms.recent-window: Fit the shipped RatioQuantileModel on training rows with estimated_on >= start. Rows before start are ignored.
mechanisms.shrink-quantile: Blend each shipped size-bucket quantile toward the pooled quantile: q = (n * q_bucket + k * q_pooled) / (n + k). n = 0 uses the pooled quantile. There is no hard switch at 30.
mechanisms.round-by-bucket: An estimate is round when its hours are in round_hours. Use that subset's quantiles inside the shipped size bucket when the subset has at least min_cases ratios; otherwise use the shipped bucket-or-pooled rule.
mechanisms.size-buckets: The shipped estimator with the listed edges instead of shipped_edges, including the same fallback when a bucket has fewer than min_cases ratios.
